trial.name: Wolverine WVR-6R — silhouette study
trial.notes: New independent WVR-6R silhouettes with left dorsal six-port rack and right forearm cannon. No inherited humanoid component generator. Shape review 2: remove inaccurate chest port mass, simplify shoulder launcher, keep forearm cannon smaller than whole chest. Reference iteration 3: independently traced ten-sided angular chest and forebody, sloped shoulder cowlings, tall rectangular six-port rack beside helmet, and narrow angular pilot helmet rather than bulbous cylinders. Reference iteration 4: broken-up wide shoulder shields, one clenched fist, distinctly separate cannon shroud in right arm, angular knee/thigh guards and narrower reverse-taper greaves. Fifth pass: separate armored hip section bridges chest and leg roots; individual six SRM bores remain on high asymmetric left launcher. Pass 6: individually framed six-port missile rack with physically carved 2x3 launch openings. Pass 7: hollow right-arm AC5 muzzle frame and hand with individually shaped knuckles and thumb, with no dangling fingers. Pass 8: replace rounded Wolverine torso masses with planar swept armor cowlings, bring shoulder pads closer to reference and reduce shared overlap along the shoulder seams. Shape pass 9: leaned chamfered pauldron armor, forward rectangular visor helmet and thin radio antennas, broad shouldered segmented chest. References WVR-6R FSW ink and multiple miniature viewpoints. Pass 10: replaced hollow-appearing pauldron caps with solid tapered shoulder-shell contours; split the single hexagonal chest into two swept structural breastplates. Pass 11: chamfered plate-sided WVR pauldrons with hard flat faces (not ovals) and defined projecting shin fairings at knee-to-ankle; checked against WVR-6R FSW drawing. Pass 12: replace egg-like shoulder cylinders with canted eight-sided armor shields of intentionally drawn front-facing x/y profiles, per WVR-6R FSW line art. Pass 13: vertically separate reference-accurate hip and upper torso: stretch the individually authored leg shapes to 34 grid units while translating the unmodified upper components 7 units, preventing stubby limb-to-torso appearance. Pass 14: compared WVR-6R FSW front illustration, SYZ dual pose, alternate CAD two perspectives. Shrink outer side torso blocks and cant the upper-arm plates so the torso is separated from shoulders by real geometry rather than enormous oval shoulder balls. Pass 15: WVR miniature comparison drove narrower hard-shoulder guards and shallow upper chest shields, replacing the large drooping pointed breastplates in Godot render. Pass 16: WVR-6R FSW front and posed resin show a flatter V-shaped breastplate and unmistakably long forearm cannon. Shallow angular torso plates plus forward-projecting AC5 cradle. Pass 17: WVR-6R leg plates redrawn as six-faced angular tapered thigh/shin solids matching the FSW front and dual-posed miniatures. Target is visibly different from Atlas rounded heavy leg armor, not more polygons or damage detail. Pass 18: WVR6R upright faceted pauldron shields now have rising pitched roofs and narrow lower anchors. AC/5 forearm shroud is angled forward rather than a drooping generic arm block. Pass 19: alternate WVR-6R pose motivated a sharply roofed swept plate rather than a pill. Angular shin fronts are now explicit separate armor geometry, not detail overlay. Pass 20: WVR-6R cannon stays on the forearm, with a long narrow box muzzle distinctly separated from its missile shoulder and chest armor; correct model-specific silhouette. Pass 22: matched WVR-6R three-quarter CGL/SYZ and AfterDark: shrink central shoulder root, lengthen flat canted upper-arm shield with 8-corner bevel, maintain real gap to ribcage, push separate rectangular pilot visor forward. Pass 23: six-vertex angular front shoulder shields replace ellipse-like WVR pauldrons; expose independent left/right mechanical knee joint under shortened upper-thigh armor, following the WVR-6R CGL plate/leg reference. Pass 24: rebuild WVR knee/shin as a canted forward knee wedge over a slimmer planar shin, in contrast to Atlas's straight armor slab. Source silhouettes based on AfterDark and SYZ two-view photos. Pass 25 CGL first: use actual plastic beginner box Wolverine and 2024 premium assembled three-quarter pose to bound shoulder breadth and preserve slim cannon-arm gap; not resin proxy exaggerated pauldrons. CGL pass 26: distinct compact Wolverine helmet with horizontal recessed visor and raised aft thruster hump. Avoid Atlas-style skull face; source is assembled CGL premium miniature. CGL pass27: 2019 and Premium Wolverine photos show a comparatively slim long AC5 forearm gun, not the earlier overly wide Atlas-like cannon bar; narrow muzzle and move inward, preserving independent RA part. CGL pass28: slimmer Wolverine wedge-toe feet and short kneecaps with exposed actuator yokes instead of Atlas assault weight rectangular double boot toe guards. CGL pass29: after pass28 actual render, reduce WVR upper armor plate height and width so shoulder no longer looks as large as Atlas's rounded assault bells; preserve upright shield and thinner exposed elbow. CGL plastic pass 32: Beginner Box WVR-6R and Catalyst premium Wolverine multi-angle photos prioritized. Narrowed inner pauldron edges and created visible articulated connection under the shield. Arms remain asymmetric; no cloned Atlas arm. CGL plastic pass 34: reduced Wolverine forearm bloat, added a real taper at elbow-to-fist and AC5 shroud, redrew thighs as narrow faceted sections instead of Atlas-like tree-trunks. Keep 55-ton gait clear from Atlas's heavy legs. CGL plastic pass 36: corrected bloated Wolverine AC/5 forearm housing, reducing 7-wide by 11-long tube to compact square 5-wide by 9-long housing with recessed rear throat, maintaining independent raised cannon arm. Pass 39 (CGL Wolverine Premium 2025 + 2019 AGoAC front and left 3/4): shorter faceted pauldrons, restored smaller joint cores. Relieved bloating and maintained cannon-arm asymmetry. Pass 41 (front/side silhouette overlap audit): small interior hip bearing cores bridge pelvis-to-thigh missing contacts without bulking outer armor; paired mirrored parts maintain pivot symmetry. CGL plastic pass39: AGOAC Wolverine front and side pauldron roofs narrower and more canted than previous large oval slabs, preserved independent shoulder joints with 2-3 grid overlap into upper arm; AC5 stays right arm. CGL pass42: Wolverine AGOAC front shows much narrower torso-root width than Atlas. Side torso shells now taper inward while launcher remains on left shoulder; maintain actual shoulder yoke and cannon root to prevent detached appearance. CGL plastic pass45: AGOAC Wolverine shoulder-mounted SRM6 flattened and lowered into the left collar instead of towering above its small cockpit. Retain six physically empty 2x3 forward mouths and chassis-specific asymmetric right arm cannon. CGL shape pass47 joint audit: placed a slim internal right elbow connection between asymmetrically cannon-equipped forearm and upper-arm armor, joining them through actual occupied cells while keeping outer negative space. Plastic-weighted pass49: AGOAC Wolverine and official premium front/3-4: trim both outer shoulder-shell and pauldron margins, flatten drooping breastplates and keep narrower CGL medium-torso proportions. Plastic-weighted pass52: AGOAC Wolverine has small angled outer shoulder caps with narrow elbow/forearm, not a second 100t Atlas. Reduced outer arm/shield overhang and tall corners, narrow cannon-side limb and left thigh with negative space retained. CGL plastic pass52: flatten inflated breast plates and add a recessed central chassis keel instead of generic twin blisters. Plastic-weighted pass55: Wolverine AGOAC rear and premium CGL multi-angle backpack has independently bounded rear jump-jet/nozzle clusters. Add narrow paired jet-casing geometry joined to existing central backpack, not broad boxes inflating shoulders. Plastic-weighted pass57 (side/rear actual Godot diagnostic): Wolverine's forearm AC5 was floating visibly in side profile. Reconnected it through a hand-authored tapered diagonal breech/forearm mount from forward cannon casing z=-19 to shoulder-arm shell z=-3 with continuous cross sections and real occupied contact. Avoid added bloat at outer x width. Plastic-weighted joint correction after pass57 CI: extend AC5 diagonal breech mount four voxels into rear of the cannon shroud (without covering forward muzzle), achieving actual shared occupied cells rather than visual near-contact. CGL shape pass 59: Lower compact pauldron roofs and expose narrow shoulder roots; primary references are current plastic from multiple angles. CGL shape pass 62: Lean CGL wedge shoes and narrow lower-shin guards; primary references are current plastic from multiple angles. CGL sculpt pass 64: Lower rear backpack and bridge torso-to-jumpjet bases; plastic photos front/side/rear weighted primary. CGL sculpt pass 67: Taper thigh and shin into visibly separate medium-mech knee articulation; plastic photos front/side/rear weighted primary. CGL plastic pass 70: Give existing aft jump-jet pods physically hollow exhaust mouths; multi-angle side/rear audit. CGL shape pass 73: Taper the AC5 forearm armor so cannon housing is a distinct weapon, not a box arm; verify from plastic front, side, rear. Pass 78: one right arm only. Removed oversized hanging right fist and long parallel fake forearm (duplicated anatomy); replaced with singular angled armored AC5 arm and short, mostly internal overlapping mount. Prior test's upper/gun contacts preserved. Pass79: right cannon sleeve and elbow remain exactly one articulated assembly; no independent dangling right fist or duplicate frontal rod. Pass 85: CGL AGOAC frontal shoulder armor narrowed at top and across center, preserving physically separate paired shoulder yokes; no extra second gun hand. Pass84: CGL AGOAC front/top shows compact shoulder shields, not broad oval Atlas-like masses. Removed top two cells and shortened fore-aft thickness; right arm AC5 kept singular. Pass 90: CGL AGOAC WVR-6R single AC5 arm silhouette preserved; right torso shell shortened/flattened independently of launcher shoulder, reducing boxy right cowl bulk. Pass 93: physically single right forearm and AC/5 breech, tapering along diagonal into the upper arm; cannot recreate the duplicate second fist. Pass 96: WVR lower-leg CGL plastic has canted narrow shin face and exposed knee joint, unlike Atlas's broad forward shin slab. Passes 98–117: CGL-plastic-led front/overhead silhouette and joint corrections; shape-only. Full audit in docs/graphics/shape-refinement-cycle-9.md. In-engine verification pending. Passes 118–127: 10 synchronized silhouette refinement cycles, shape-only and CGL plastic prioritization; see review document. Passes 128–132 large component resculpting all three each pass; review source gate before high-density detail. Passes 133–137 major plastic-led hand-shaped thigh, cannon arm and digitigrade anatomy revisions; all three edited in every pass. Passes 143–147 major plastic-led component proportions: visible skull face, compact Wolverine launcher/dual hands, Jenner disc glazing/neck, all models per pass. Final launcher muzzle plane alignment: compact six-port mouth tips placed at z=-15.5 on physical rack front, rather than floating 2 voxels ahead. Passes 148–152 rebuilt proportions, connection angles and adjoining silhouettes; full five-view checks are separate. Passes 153–157 fit each part to adjacent components and attachment angle, true plastic shape source, no subdivision. Passes 158–162 coordinated whole-shape intervention, Wolverine one bent right arm with hand gripping AC5 behind barrel (no vertical second forearm). Passes 163–167 reprofile Atlas shoulders, Wolverine single right hand/AC5 and Jenner disc and joints in every pass. Passes 168–172 all-model relationship and component negative space sculpt; single right gun arm invariant. Pass 173: larger whole-assembly connection and angle resculpt, Wolverine sharply bent single gun/hand arm. Pass 174: whole-assembly scale/angle refinement with one Wolverine right arm. Pass 175: whole-assembly scale/angle refinement with one Wolverine right arm. Pass 176: whole-assembly scale/angle refinement with one Wolverine right arm. Pass 177: Atlas hip/thigh ratio, Wolverine single bent elbow profile, Jenner angled cockpit saddle and feet.
